g.text: Never blocked by any ML call above
no request body, no timeout set

PROTECTED ML CALLS REQUIRE THE OPERATIONS TOKEN
The backend sends X-ML-Operations-Token for predict-category,
generate-description, retrain-model, and spending forecast. The /ping
The backend's own addExpense controller never
does, before the user submits; category prediction

svg.text: Heavy arrows are region hand-offs; the cyan one is the HTTP response. Light arrows are steps inside a region. Absent mechanisms are named in a note, never drawn as implemented steps.
